scope: Analytical foreground/background bounds for gradient/canvas contrast checks axe could not resolve. Does not resolve offscreen/covered-node incompletes or establish complete WCAG conformance.
method: WCAG sRGB relative luminance. Gate evaluates all 16 zero/max-alpha layer combinations in CSS stacking order, ignoring text shadows. Transparent canvas badges use white underneath for a conservative brightest background. Library uses its brightest gradient endpoint.
